body:
Refined the Models pillar into event-sourcing per founder real-time direction (JSONL log as source of truth, SQL databases as rebuildable projections). Documented the real shipped API (PARENA's log/event.prn/log/jsonl.prn/log/projector.prn) and its real, named restrictions. After the founder ran the queued sqlite3/postgresql-client install script, SQLite became live-verified (surfacing and fixing a real shell-quoting bug along the way). Phase B2 marked done; MySQL/PostgreSQL live verification remains blocked on server/credential access only.

⚓ ☃
title: FRAMEWORK_NORTHSTAR.md -- event-sourcing refinement, SQLite live-verified
